clips.text: In this world everything is upside down and anyone who is meditating will have to put everything right side up!
One should not try to know life but to know death, and then the mysteries of life are revealed to him.
One should not ask for any security and then there is no insecurity at all.
Bunan says in a poem: While living be a dead man, be thoroughly dead, and then behave as you like because then all is well.
